page_concerns.concern: Downloads and runs code from an unknown GitHub project
Asks for Screen Recording and Accessibility access

steps.title: Install the Droid helper tool
steps.explanation: Installs Droid, the tool CalHack uses to run approved steps on your Mac.
concerns: Adds a third-party tool that can run commands on your Mac

steps.title: Install the project's packages
steps.explanation: Downloads the parts the app needs to run.
concerns: Needs Node.js and npm, which may not be on this Mac
Runs code from an unknown project with few stars

steps.title: Download the Electron framework
steps.explanation: Downloads the app framework the first time it is needed.

steps.title: Create your settings file
steps.explanation: Copies the example settings file so you can add your keys.

steps.title: Add your API keys to the settings file
steps.explanation: Open the .env file and paste your Anthropic key from console.anthropic.com. Also add your Factory key.
concerns: Keep these keys private; they may cost money

steps.title: Start the demo pages
steps.explanation: Starts sample web pages on this computer. This is optional and only for trying examples.

steps.title: Start CalHack
steps.explanation: Starts the app. Its shield icon appears in the menu bar at the top of the screen.

steps.title: Allow the macOS permissions
steps.explanation: When macOS asks, click Allow so CalHack can see your screen and work with other apps.
concerns: Gives the app access to see your screen
